name: OCRBench v2
intro: OCRBench v2 是面向大多模态模型的高难度双语视觉文本基准，聚焦单图场景，覆盖31个场景、八类OCR能力和23项任务。公开集包含10,000个经人工核验的问答对，另有1,500张人工收集并标注、用于抗污染排行榜评测的私有图像。
org: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, South China University of Technology, University of Adelaide, ByteDance
build_method: 数据集整合, 人工核验, 私有测试集
task_type: OCR, 文本定位, 结构解析, 视觉文本推理
eval_feature: 双语, 23项任务, 31个场景, 多指标
scale: 10,000个公开问答对 + 1,500张私有图像；23项任务；31个场景
task_type_en: OCR, text localization, structured parsing, visual text reasoning
build_method_en: Dataset Integration, Human Verification, Private Test Set
intro_en: OCRBench v2 is a high-difficulty bilingual visual-text benchmark for large multimodal models. It focuses on single-image settings and spans 31 scenarios, eight OCR capabilities, and 23 tasks. The public set contains 10,000 human-verified QA pairs, accompanied by 1,500 manually collected and annotated private images for contamination-resistant leaderboard evaluation.
scale_en: 10,000 public QA pairs + 1,500 private images; 23 tasks; 31 scenarios

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.00321 Sections 3–5 and Appendices A.2–A.6 plus the official MultimodalOCR repository and OCRBench v2 project. The diagrams preserve the single-image scope, 81 screened academic datasets plus private data, 31 scenarios, 23 tasks grouped into eight capabilities, bilingual instructions, structured Markdown/JSON/LaTeX outputs, coordinate normalization to 0–1,000, manual annotation of added images, review of every public instruction and correction of about 1% annotation errors, the 10,000 human-verified public QA pairs with 7,400 English and 2,600 Chinese images, and the separate withheld 1,500-image human-annotated private test set. Evaluation routes parsing to TEDS, localization to IoU, relation extraction to F1, long reading to the mean of BLEU/METEOR/F1/normalized edit distance, counting to exact match or normalized L1, and basic VQA to exact match, containment, or ANLS before averaging eight capability scores on a 0–100 scale.
